verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing to ask of an always-on agent product, so the axis applies. However, the runtime probe found no dots-specific CLI: dots is reached only through ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, calls and the mobile app. The Codex CLI listed in the docs index belongs to a separate product that dots can delegate to, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
